title: Long Crude Oil (WTI)
prompt: Buy 3m 85-95 call spread on WTI Crude
outlook: I have a bullish outlook on crude oil. The combination of persistent geopolitical tensions and strong global demand is creating a tight supply environment, pushing prices past recent resistance levels.
pricedIn: The market has not fully priced in the persistence of the geopolitical risk premium and the resilience of the US economy, which continues to demand energy despite higher rates.
structure: I expect oil to test the $90-$95 range. I will buy a 3-month WTI 85-95 call spread to limit upfront cost while capturing the upside breakout.
risk: A sudden diplomatic resolution to geopolitical tensions or unexpectedly poor non-farm payroll data could lead to a sharp sell-off. The risk is strictly limited to the option premium paid.

title: Long Gold (XAU/USD)
outlook: I am bullish on Gold. Focus is turning to the Federal Reserve's policy meeting and U.S. non-farm payrolls data, while a weaker dollar and cooling interest rate hike expectations provide support.
pricedIn: While a delayed rate cut is partially priced in, the options market underestimates the structural shift and the persistent safe-haven premium from ongoing geopolitical tensions.
structure: I expect the momentum to continue, so I will buy a 3-month XAU/USD 2300-2400 call spread to capture the upside while reducing the net premium paid.
risk: A sudden re-acceleration in US inflation could force the Fed to hold rates higher for longer, hurting non-yielding assets. The maximum loss is strictly limited to the option premium paid.
